messages:
lina: Quick sync request — new partner EdgeScale is ready to integrate marketplace usage. They report device-hours and per-instance credits. Need to map to our credit units and reconciliation flow. cc @maya_pm @samir @jon_enginfra

maya_pm: Can you share a sample payload? we'll need event_id, timestamp (with tz or offset), device_id, meter_id, quantity. Also expected peak rate?

lina: Sample they sent:
{"event_id":"es-evt-20260320-0001","device_id":"edge-42","meter_id":"inst_hours","timestamp":"2026-03-19T22:00:00-05:00","quantity":4.5}

samir: Conversion note: device-hours -> compute-credits. Need a conversion factor and rounding policy. Who owns that mapping? Also clarify billing window (UTC EOD?)

jon_enginfra: Ingestion needs an idempotency/dedupe key. Recommend event_id + device_id + date(window_start). Normalize to UTC on ingest. Late arrivals allowed up to 7 days per current marketplace feeds.

alex_recon: For nightly reconciliation I'll compare partner totals vs ingested totals. Example: SUM(credits) grouped by partner and date. Set alert threshold 0.5% or $100 whichever larger.

priya_legal: Per contract, EdgeScale accepted per-instance billing with 1% rounding tolerance and 60-day dispute window. Surface that in alerts and playbook.

maya_pm: Onboarding checklist I'm proposing: schema signoff (tz mandatory), small test batch (10k events across regions), validation run + reconcile, parity smoke tests, enable prod feed.

lina: Owners: maya_pm schema/tests; samir conversion & pricing mapping; jon_ingest idempotency/TTL; alex_recon dashboard; priya_legal contract edgecases.

samir: Rounding direction? Prefer round-to-nearest to avoid bias.

priya_legal: I'll confirm whether contract requires directional rounding. Update by EOD.

partners-bot: New task created: "edgescale-integration-checklist" assigned to maya_pm, due 2026-03-24.

alex_recon: One gotcha: their sample used America/Chicago offset. Insist on UTC or explicit offset to avoid daily window shifts.

lina: Agreed. maya_pm add tz requirement and fail-fast for missing offset.

maya_pm: Adding a staging endpoint: POST /partner/edgescale/v1/ingest (staging). Will return 422 for schema violations and provide schema validation response payload.

jon_enginfra: Ingest rate: they may hit 50k events/hr. We'll autoscale but set soft throttle at 20 rps initially. What's backpressure policy? 429 or queue?

samir: Prefer short queue (30s) with retries, fallback to 429 when queue full. Export metrics: ingest_rate, dedupe_rate, late_arrival_count.

lina: Alex, can you spin up the initial reconciliation dashboard and ACL it for partner view?

alex_recon: Dashboard created: https://console.redwood/apps/dashboards/edgescale-recon — will set ACLs and add nightly reconciliation job. :white_check_mark:

lina: Thanks everyone. I'll draft the partner integration doc and ping for review tomorrow AM.
